result.reason: The added clause reaches the preferred position by requiring up to six months of transition assistance at then-current rates, a machine-readable data return within 30 days, and subsequent deletion certification. However, it unnecessarily extends the return and deletion obligations to all Works and Confidential Information, potentially altering existing work-product delivery, ownership, payment, retention, and confidentiality arrangements. “Company data” is also not presented as a defined term, and requiring all Works and Confidential Information to be returned in machine-readable format may be impractical. The transition and data-return requirements should be limited to Company/Customer Data, with any necessary backup, legal-retention, and archival exceptions.
